coverage.notes: This case verifies that an unsupported image MIME type is rejected before direct upload begins.

preconditions: The seeded standard user can sign in on the local-dev frontend.
The local frontend and backend development servers are already running.
The backend upload-ticket endpoint validates allowed MIME types for gallery uploads.
The prepared invalid-format fixture exists under e2e/fixtures/.
assertions: The upload dialog can be opened.
Submitting the unsupported fixture returns 422 from the upload-ticket endpoint.
The upload dialog shows an error state and direct upload does not proceed.
notes: Uses e2e/fixtures/invalid-format.gif to verify upload-ticket MIME rejection on the existing local-dev lane.
